message.content: {"tool": "finish", "message": "Implemented reports.export.export_csv in reports/export.py: materializes columns (validating unique strings, ValueError otherwise), builds header + one record per row with comma delimiters and CRLF endings, RFC 4180 minimal quoting with quote doubling, preserves embedded CR/LF and Unicode, maps missing/None to empty strings, stringifies other values, ignores unselected fields, works with one-shot generators and empty inputs, and does not mutate inputs. Added optional tests in tests/test_export.py; all 16 tests pass (including protected tests/test_reports.py)."}
